title: Add subtract function with unit test
description: Implement a subtract(a, b) function in backend/app.py alongside the existing add(a, b) function, and write a matching unit test that verifies correct subtraction behavior (including edge cases like negative numbers and zero).
acceptance_criteria: backend/app.py contains a subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b
The existing add(a, b) function remains unchanged and functional
A unit test exists that calls subtract(a, b) and asserts correct results for at least positive, negative, and zero-value inputs
All existing and new unit tests pass
